content_of_post_to_comment: I’m deeply tempted to chase people who misunderstand me. I want to explain myself one more time, send one more message, and somehow make them see my heart. Jesus didn’t chase every person who misunderstood Him. I’m still learning that.
comment: There’s a difference between seeking reconciliation and seeking control over someone else’s perception. Maybe wisdom is knowing when explanation serves love and when silence protects peace.
